title: Slices of one C¹ chart piece are countably n-rectifiable with tangent planes T_xM ∩ ∇f^⊥ (Simon Ch. 6, Lemma 4.1(1),(2), one piece)
statement:
Assume (TL): for all P, n ∈ ℕ, every open U ⊆ ℝ^P and all Borel sets A ⊆ B ⊆ U with Hⁿ(B ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U (Hⁿ = μHE[n]), for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ A and every linear subspace Q of ℝ^P: B has approximate tangent space Q at x iff A does (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt, Simon Ch. 3, 1.4).
Let P, n ∈ ℕ, V ⊆ ℝ^{n+1} open, ψ : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ^P C¹ on V and injective on V with Dψ(y) injective for y ∈ V, C ⊆ V compact, Y ⊆ C Borel, F : ℝ^{n+1} → ℝ C¹, f : ℝ^P → ℝ with f(ψ(y)) = F(y) for y ∈ Y, and G : ℝ^P → ℝ^P such that for every y ∈ Y: G(ψ(y)) ∈ Dψ(y)(ℝ^{n+1}) and ⟨G(ψ(y)), Dψ(y)e⟩ = DF(y)e for all e. For t ∈ ℝ let S_t := ψ(Y) ∩ {G ≠ 0} ∩ f⁻¹(t). Then for every t ∈ ℝ:
(i) S_t is countably n-rectifiable;
(ii) if Hⁿ(S_t) < ∞, then for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ S_t and every y ∈ Y with ψ(y) = x, S_t has approximate tangent space Dψ(y)(ℝ^{n+1}) ∩ G(x)^⊥ (= range Dψ(y) ⊓ (ℝ∙G(x))ᗮ) at x.
